findings.passage: Among many other things, as Representative, I will work to finally enact redistricting reform to prevent racial and partisan gerrymandering and to ensure meaningful political representation for every community; introduce automatic registration for all voting eligible North Carolinians, including those turning 18; fight against voter ID requirements and other attempts to disenfranchise voters of color and poor voters; expand the right to vote and participation in our democracy through greater access to voter registration, early voting, and vote-by-mail, and the introduction of ballot drop-boxes; and increase funding and training for county boards of elections.
findings.note: Answer in his 2022 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, when he ran for the NC House (District 56) and lost the primary. He says he would fight voter ID requirements and expand registration, early voting, vote-by-mail and drop-boxes. Date is the 2022 campaign year; exact day of the answer is not shown on the page.

findings.motion: House Bill 958 Election Law Changes, Senate Second Reading, roll call 693
findings.note: Garson is listed among the Noes (28 Ayes, 13 Noes). The House committee substitute text on the legislature site includes a provisional ballot when a voter has no photo ID, a cure deadline to show photo ID, a photocopy of ID with absentee ballots, and citizenship questions for voter registration at drivers license offices.
